sponsored.t: Relates to enforcement of toll collection regulations and license plate violations
sponsored.sum: Relates to enforcement of toll collection regulations and license plate violations; permits registration suspension, seizure and liens.

sponsored.t: Prohibits cannabis inversion
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "cannabis supply chain integrity and anti-inversion act"; prohibits any act or omission involving illicit cannabis; provides penalties for such cannabis inversion.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "gas tax holiday act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "gas tax holiday act"; provides that from the first of the month after the effective date of the section until December 31, 2027 the taxes imposed on retail sales of fuel gas, motor fuel and diesel motor fuel shall be exempt from certain taxes.

sponsored.t: Restricts the performance of surgical devocalization procedures on dogs and cats
sponsored.sum: Restricts the performance of surgical devocalization procedures on dogs and cats; prohibited for reasons of convenience in keeping or handling a dog or cat.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of children and family services to establish a center for fatherhood initiatives
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of children and family services to establish a center for fatherhood initiatives to issue grants to initiatives regarding the promotion and advancement of fatherhood, including but not limited to all underserved fatherhood groups to help expand opportunities to improve parenting knowledge, attitudes, and self-efficacy.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the office of cannabis management and cannabis control board establish a track and trace program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the office of cannabis management and cannabis control board to establish a track and trace program; requires certain tracking requirements on cannabis sold within the state.

sponsored.t: Requires a detailed determination in orders determining a motion
sponsored.sum: Requires a detailed determination in orders determining a motion, no longer up to a judge's discretion.

sponsored.t: Establishes a New York state veterans' and service member law book
sponsored.sum: Establishes a New York state veterans' and service member law book of a compilation of all state statutes governing the rights, privileges, benefits and services afforded to veterans, service members and their families.

sponsored.t: Relates to the state cannabis advisory board
sponsored.sum: Adds a non-voting member from the division of service-disabled veterans' business development to the state cannabis advisory board.

sponsored.t: Grants immunity to law enforcement employees who intervene against police misconduct
sponsored.sum: Grants immunity from liability and professional retaliation against a law enforcement employee who intervenes against police misconduct committed by another member of law enforcement.

sponsored.t: Authorizes minors to operate temporary businesses without certain licenses or permits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes minors to operate temporary businesses operating for less than thirty days and generating less than five thousand dollars in profit per calendar year without certain licenses or permits; permits local government or law enforcement to require such temporary business to move if the location is determined to pose a substantial risk to health and safety.

sponsored.t: Establishes a Black youth suicide prevention task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Black youth suicide prevention task force to study the current mental health practices and suicide prevention of Black youth age 5 through 18 years and make recommendations therefor; provides for the number of members, manner of appointment and the topics to be reviewed.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of financial assistance to museums, zoos, botanical gardens, aquariums and other cultural institutions located in low-income urban, suburban or rural communities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the provision of financial assistance to museums, zoos, botanical gardens, aquariums and other cultural institutions located in low-income urban, suburban or rural communities, or that provide educational services to students from such communities.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction in arts and music education to be incorporated into curriculums for all public school students
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction in arts and music education to be incorporated into curriculums for all public school students; requires school districts to ensure that appropriately certified teachers are providing such education; authorizes rules and regulations consistent with such provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of veterans' services to establish and maintain a database of resources available in the state for veterans, members of the uniformed services, and their families
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of veterans' services to establish and maintain, in consultation and collaboration with other state agencies, a searchable database on the department's website providing resources available in the state for veterans, members of the uniformed services, and their families.

sponsored.t: Establishes the veteran career assistance program within the SUNY and CUNY systems
sponsored.sum: Establishes the veteran career assistance program within the SUNY and CUNY systems to provide veterans with assistance in resume writing and employment placement services.

sponsored.t: Establishes a Black Leadership Institute within the state university of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Black Leadership Institute within the state university of New York as an initiative for Black leaders in higher education with a mission to retain and grow from within SUNY a greater proportion of Black professionals at SUNY campuses; creates an eight member advisory council.

sponsored.t: Requires certain public authorities to establish a cashless tolling amnesty program
sponsored.sum: Requires certain public authorities to establish a cashless tolling amnesty program between August first, two thousand twenty-five and December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-five for cashless tolls collected between April twenty-third, two thousand sixteen and June twenty-ninth, two thousand twenty-five.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the New York state federal relations office; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the New York state federal relations office in Washington, DC; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of black male excellence
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of black male excellence to analyze and provide recommendations regarding issues relating to black males including education, criminal justice, health, mental health, economic opportunity, employment, fatherhood, mentorship, violence, public safety, and quality of life.

sponsored.t: Creates a temporary state commission concerning the incidence of asthma in the Bronx
sponsored.sum: Creates a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of asthma in the borough of the Bronx in New York city.

sponsored.t: Establishes a grant program to assist providers in purchasing opioid antagonists alongside automated external defibrillators
sponsored.sum: Establishes a grant program to assist providers in purchasing opioid antagonists alongside automated external defibrillators; establishes criteria for such grant program.

sponsored.t: Moves the date of the presidential primary to the first Tuesday in March
sponsored.sum: Moves the date of the presidential primary to the first Tuesday in March, also known as Super Tuesday.

sponsored.t: Allows certain methods for service of process
sponsored.sum: Allows certain methods for service of process including by electronic means.
